hadith:
Prostration During Recital of Qur'an - Narrated Ibn `Umar:

When the Prophet (ﷺ) recited a Sura that contained the prostration he would prostrate and we would do the same and some of us (because of the heavy rush) could not find a place for prostration.
message: When we face hardship or deprivation in this world, we should remember that Allah is Al-Ghaffaar, the Constant Forgiver, who offers us mercy and opportunities to repent and improve ourselves. By prostrating in worship and submitting to Allah during difficult times, we align ourselves with His forgiveness and find solace in His compassion, knowing that He understands our struggles and seeks our spiritual elevation.
name:
Al Ghaffaar - الْغَفَّارُ - The Forgiving

The meaning of Al Ghaffaar is 'The Constant Forgiver' or 'The Forgiving One'. It emphasizes Allah's willingness to forgive sins repeatedly and His mercy towards humanity. This name signifies that Allah continually provides opportunities for repentance and seeks to cover and forgive shortcomings, highlighting His compassion and understanding.
verse:
Al-Ghashiyah - The Overwhelming - 88:6-7

They will have no food except a foul, thorny shrub, neither nourishing nor satisfying hunger.
